factors.name: manufacturingReadiness
factors.basis: NuScale and MillenniTEK reported successful fabrication of first-of-a-kind boron-oxide pellets for NuScale's passive emergency core cooling system on September 1, 2026, advancing a specialized safety component and manufacturing process.

risks: First-of-a-kind component fabrication is a readiness milestone, not evidence of completed plant construction or commercial electricity production.
unknowns: Production-scale qualification, cost, schedule and deployment quantities were not disclosed.

perspectives.name: expectations-execution

factors.name: commercialReadiness
factors.basis: NuScale's Q2 2026 release reported $1.9 billion of cash, cash equivalents and short- and long-term investments, an NRC-certified design, more than 60 specialized supply-chain partners and over 30 executed agreements.

risks: Liquidity and supply-chain preparation do not eliminate first-project execution, customer financing, schedule or deployment risk.
unknowns: Timing and economics of the first revenue-producing deployment remain uncertain.

facts: NuScale and MillenniTEK successfully fabricated first-of-a-kind boron-oxide pellets for the passive ECCS.
The companies characterized the work as advancing specialized component manufacturing toward commercialization readiness.
NuScale reported $1.9 billion in cash, cash equivalents and short- and long-term investments.
Management stated the design holds U.S. NRC certification and cited more than 60 specialized supply-chain partners with over 30 agreements executed.

result: Fresh September manufacturing-readiness evidence plus Q2 liquidity/supply-chain context packaged for Alpha; deployment economics remain unresolved and numeric scoring remains Alpha-owned.
